LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 15.1.1 ORAL REPORTS: NEWS (ROLE PLAY)

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.1: Listening and speaking 15.1.1 Oral Reports: News (role play)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and speaking 15.1.1 Oral Reports: News (role play), part of Strand 15 in Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: why? 2. What is an oral report? 3. When are you required to present an oral report?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch a recorded grade appropriate news report on tourist attraction sites in the world, brainstorm in groups on importance of body language in reading an oral report,

2. dramatize reading news reports on world tourist sttraction sites,

3. practise timed reading in pairs and small groups,

4. in pairs or small groups, prepare and present (role play) short news reports on tourist attraction sites in the world,

5. listen and critique others as they orally present reports. 1. Who is your favourite news presenter and why? 2.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch a recorded grade appropriate news report on tourist attraction sites in the world, brainstorm in groups on importance of body language in reading an oral report,
2. dramatize reading news reports on world tourist sttraction sites,
3. practise timed reading in pairs and small groups,
4. in pairs or small groups, prepare and present (role play) short news reports on tourist attraction sites in the world,
5. listen and critique others as they orally present reports. 1. Who is your favourite news presenter and why? 2.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and speaking 15.1.1 Oral Reports: News (role play) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: It is enhanced as they watch and listen to audio visual recordings of news oral reports.

• Communication and collaboration: It is enhanced as they work in pairs and groups.

Values:
• Respect: It is enhanced as the learner listens and critiques others as they orally present reports.

• Love: It is promoted as the learner listens and records others’ speeches

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Effective communication: It is promoted as the learner orally presents news reports.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Creative Arts and Sports and Kiswahili also require oral presentation of reports.
